VERDICT goal: the source node's goal (prompt.txt:38) is to remove the REFINED_FROM edges that close lineage cycles, archiving each into a signed receipt; this delta commit keeps that rule and only moves the residual-cycle judgment inside it, so signed_manifest.py:8967-8984 now adapts the surviving edge list to catalog_ordering._find_cyclic_components instead of carrying its own recursive traversal.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when requires an edge-archive operation whose receipt preserves the full edge snapshot and a disposable-graph test that archives a planted cycle and refuses an edge outside the manifest, with no added tests/standard_names failure ids; tests/standard_names/test_signed_edge_archive.py:341 adds the delegation test, test_signed_edge_archive-repair.log:25 records 7 passed, and suite-base.log/suite-head.log carry the identical 13 failure ids at 9b42761afd and 0bf57eb71 (0 added).
VERDICT write_paths: manifest.md lists five granted paths including imas_codex/standard_names/signed_manifest.py and tests/standard_names/test_signed_edge_archive.py; git diff --stat 7fbf45c44..0bf57eb71 touches exactly those two files (67 insertions, 20 deletions) and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read in full; status complete, after_suite now records revision 0bf57eb71 with exit_status 1, completed true and the same 13 failure ids as the base arm, and test_logs name test_signed_edge_archive-repair.log whose summary line 25 records 7 passed, although that log's own header at line 1 names 7fbf45c44.
